# EXTERNAL_QUERY on Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/federated_query_functions#postgresql_mapping
#
# Each query needs a connection named postgres in the US multi-region, to a Cloud SQL for
# PostgreSQL instance; the queries read no tables.

# Whether character keeps the padding that PostgreSQL gives it.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT 'a'::char(3) AS x''')
?>

# Which digits real keeps once it is FLOAT64.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.1::real AS x')
?>

# How numeric beyond NUMERIC's scale and range becomes NUMERIC.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.0000000005::numeric AS x')
?>

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1e30::numeric AS x')
?>

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT 'NaN'::numeric AS x''')
?>

# How default_type_for_decimal_columns string writes numeric.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1.50::numeric(5, 2) AS x', '{"default_type_for_decimal_columns":"string"}')
?>

# Dates and times outside BigQuery's ranges.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT 'infinity'::date AS x''')
?>

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '10000-01-01'::date AS x''')
?>

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT '24:00:00'::time AS x''')
?>

# Types the mapping does not list: name, which information_schema is made of, and bit strings.

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT 'a'::name AS x''')
?>

SELECT x FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', '''SELECT B'101' AS x''')
?>

# The name of a column that the query does not name, and columns of the same name.

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1 + 1')
?>

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.postgres', 'SELECT 1 AS x, 2 AS x')
?>

# The error for a connection that does not exist.

SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('us.nosuch', 'SELECT 1 AS x')
?>
